📖 Usage

How to use filter classes and mixins

// Using filter classes directly in HTML <img class="filter--blur" src="photo.jpg"> <img class="filter--grayscale" src="photo.jpg"> <img class="filter--sepia filter--brightness-110" src="photo.jpg"> // Using mixins in SCSS .my-image { @include filter_blur(8px); } .vintage-photo { @include filter_sepia(80%); @include filter_brightness(1.1); } // Backdrop filters for glass effects .glass-card { @include backdrop_blur(12px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }
